about: Skill Tree art (2026-10-10), Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5 flare medium. Icons: 3x3 sheets on magenta (2k, 1 credit each), cut by the magenta gaps, saved as 128 px JPEG in assets/tree/icons. Backdrops: 16:9 2k, 1600 px JPEG in assets/tree/backdrops (under the window CSS dark wash). Capstone spirits: 1k transparent, cropped and alpha 254->255, assets/tree/fx. References: six spell icons (assets/icons) on one sheet for the icons and spirits; assets/ui/modal_ice.jpg for the backdrops.
